product.title: Horseback Ride on Scenic Lake Louisa Trails

description.text: See Lake Louisa State Park from a unique perspective away from the crowds during a small-group horseback ride along its scenic trails. As you walk along the 6-mile (10-kilometer) route and access places that cars can’t reach, hear interesting insights about the state park’s wildlife, history, and local culture from your guide. Note: participants must be at least eight years old, and have a BMI score of 31 or lower.No prior experience needed—the horses are used to beginners Head to lesser-known vantage points to snap photos without the crowds Learn things about Lake Louisa most travelers miss E Ideal for travelers basing in Orlando who want a guided Florida experience beyond the theme parks without coordinating boats, gear, or launch times on their own.
